exposure: BMI categories (underweight, normal weight, overweight, obese class I, obese class II, and obese class III)
outcome: Neonatal morbidities (macrosomia, large for gestational age, hypoglycaemia, low 5 min Apgar score, and respiratory distress)
finding: Women who are overweight or obese have a significantly increased risk of various adverse outcomes, including caesarean section, gestational diabetes, hypertensive disorders of pregnancy, and neonatal morbidities.
mod_finding: Obese women had an increased risk of cesarean section, and those with inter-pregnancy BMI increases of ≥3 units were more likely to have a vaginal birth in their subsequent pregnancy.
